title: Extend misroute guard to the other two file-naming write tools
context: Issue #62 identified that the worktree misrouting guard was only protecting hunch_record_decision, leaving hunch_record_correction and hunch_record_finding exposed to the same errors. A later review round (PR #76 round 9 I2) found the ORIGINAL title/decision text here overclaimed scope: it said 'all'/'every' auto-committing write tool, but nuryel_write is a FOURTH tool with the identical exposure (accepts the same cwd hint, auto-commits via flushCapture, and several facets carry related_files/affected_files) that was never covered by this work and is not guarded today -- tracked separately as issue #77 rather than left as a silent gap under an overclaimed 'every'. Touches invariant(s): con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Unified the misroute guard via a shared misrouteGuard mechanism that checks file evidence (related_files, scope_hint_file, affected_files) across the THREE auto-committing write tools this issue was scoped to (hunch_record_decision, hunch_record_correction, hunch_record_finding), eliminating the inconsistency between them. Extending the same guard to nuryel_write is out of scope for #62 and tracked as its own issue (#77).
consequences: hunch_record_correction and hunch_record_finding now have the same new/untracked file detection protection as hunch_record_decision
Guard checks are now consistent across these three tools, reducing the attack surface for worktree misroutes among them
The modified-tracked-file detection gap remains unresolved (known open issue in #75, not #62 -- #62 covered the tool-coverage extension only and closes with this work)
nuryel_write remains unguarded against the identical #54 misroute shape -- tracked in #77, not silently left uncovered by this record's original overclaim of 'every'/'all' auto-committing write tool
alternatives_rejected: Fixing each tool individually without centralizing the guard logic
Solving the modified-tracked-file gap simultaneously in this commit

Silently expanding this work's scope to also guard nuryel_write once it was noticed, rather than tracking it as its own issue -- rejected to keep #62's already-large review history (nine rounds) scoped to what it was actually about
